title.zh: 卷二十七 志第八: 河渠 黃河 漕渠盧溝河 滹沱河 漳河
title.en: Volume 27 Treatises 8: Rivers and Canals: Yellow River and Its Branches and Channels, Hutuo River, Zhang River
title.raw: 卷二十七 志第八: 河渠 黃河 漕渠盧溝河 滹沱河 漳河 Volume 27 Treatises 8: Rivers and Canals: Yellow River and Its Branches and Channels, Hutuo River, Zhang River

sentences.zh: 金始克宋，兩河悉畀劉豫。

translations.literal: When Jin first conquered Song, both He Rivers were all entrusted to Liu Yu.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jin first overran the Song, both banks of the Yellow River were handed entirely to Liu Yu.

sentences.zh: 豫亡，河遂盡入金境。

translations.literal: When Yu perished, the river then entirely entered Jin territory.
translations.idiomatic: When Yu fell, the river and its works lay wholly within Jin borders.

sentences.zh: 數十年間，或決或塞，遷徙無定。

translations.literal: Over several decades, sometimes breaching, sometimes blocked, shifting without fixed course.
translations.idiomatic: For decades it broke out or was dammed, its channel wandering without fixed line.

sentences.zh: 金人設官置屬，以主其事。

translations.literal: Jin people established offices and set subordinates to oversee the matter.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin set up offices and staff to take charge of the work.

sentences.zh: 沿河上下凡二十五埽，六在河南，十九在河北，埽設散巡河官一員。

translations.literal: Along the river above and below were twenty-five sao in all—six south of the river, nineteen north of the river—each sao having one roving river-patrol official.
translations.idiomatic: Along the full reach of the river stood twenty-five levee sections—six south of the stream, nineteen north—each with a roving river-patrol officer.

sentences.zh: 雄武、滎澤、原武、陽武、延津五埽則兼汴河事，設黃汴都巡河官一員于河陰以蒞之。

translations.literal: The five sao Xiongwu, Yingze, Yuanwu, Yangwu, and Yanjin also handled Bian River affairs; one Combined Huang-Bian regional river-patrol director was set at Heyin to oversee them.
translations.idiomatic: Xiongwu, Yingze, Yuanwu, Yangwu, and Yanjin also oversaw the Bian Canal; a single Combined Huang-Bian regional director at Heyin supervised them.

sentences.zh: 懷州、孟津、孟州及城北之四埽則兼沁水事，設黃沁都巡河官一員於懷州以臨之。

translations.literal: Huaizhou, Mengjin, Mengzhou, and the four sao north of the city wall also handled Qin River affairs; one Combined Huang-Qin regional director was set at Huaizhou to face them.
translations.idiomatic: Huaizhou, Mengjin, Mengzhou, and the four north-city sao shared Qin River duty; a Combined Huang-Qin director at Huaizhou watched over them.

sentences.zh: 崇福上下、衛南、淇上四埽屬衛南都巡河官，則居新鄉。

translations.literal: Upper and Lower Chongfu, Weinan, and Qishang four sao belonged to the Weinan regional river-patrol director, who resided at Xinxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Upper and Lower Chongfu, Weinan, and Qishang fell under the Weinan regional director, based at Xinxiang.

sentences.zh: 武城、白馬、書城、教城四埽屬浚滑都巡河官，則處教城。

translations.literal: Wucheng, Baima, Shucheng, and Jiaocheng four sao belonged to the Xun-Hua regional river-patrol director, who was stationed at Jiaocheng.
translations.idiomatic: Wucheng, Baima, Shucheng, and Jiaocheng answered to the Xun-Hua regional director at Jiaocheng.

sentences.zh: 曹甸都巡河官則總東明、西佳、孟華、淩城四埽。

translations.literal: The Caodian regional river-patrol director then oversaw Dongming, Xijia, Menghua, and Lingcheng four sao.
translations.idiomatic: The Caodian regional director commanded Dongming, Xijia, Menghua, and Lingcheng.

sentences.zh: 曹濟都巡河官則司定陶、濟北、寒山、金山四埽者也。

translations.literal: The Cao-Ji regional river-patrol director was the one who administered Dingtao, Jibei, Hanshan, and Jinshan four sao.
translations.idiomatic: The Cao-Ji regional director ran Dingtao, Jibei, Hanshan, and Jinshan.

sentences.zh: 故都巡河官凡六員。

translations.literal: Thus regional river-patrol directors numbered six in all.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were six regional river-patrol directors.

sentences.zh: 後又特設崇福上下埽都巡河官兼石橋使。

translations.literal: Later a special Upper and Lower Chongfu sao regional river-patrol director was also set, concurrently Stone Bridge commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Later they added a dedicated director for Upper and Lower Chongfu, who also served as Stone Bridge commissioner.

sentences.zh: 凡巡河官，皆從都水監廉舉，總統埽兵萬二千人，歲用薪百一十一萬三千餘束，草百八十三萬七百餘束，樁杙之木不與，此備河之恆制也。

translations.literal: All river-patrol officials were selected through integrity screening by the Directorate of Waterways, commanding twelve thousand sao troops; annual use was 1,113,000-odd bundles of firewood, 1,837,000-odd bundles of grass, pile and stake timber not included—this was the standing system for river preparedness.
translations.idiomatic: Every patrol officer came up through the Directorate of Waterways' integrity screening, commanding twelve thousand sao troops. Each year the works consumed over 1.11 million bundles of fuel wood and over 1.83 million bundles of thatch, not counting piling timber—standing river-defense scale.

sentences.zh: 大定八年六月，河決李固渡，水潰曹州城，分流于單州之境。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Dading 8 the river breached at Ligudu; water burst Caozhou city and divided within Danzhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Dading 8 the river broke at Ligudu, flooding Caozhou and splitting across Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，朝廷遣都水監梁肅往視之。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 9 the court sent Directorate of Waterways director Liang Su to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: The first month of year 9 the court sent Liang Su of the Directorate of Waterways to inspect.

sentences.zh: 河南統軍使宗室宗敘言：「大河所以決溢者，以河道積淤，不能受水故也。

translations.literal: Henan military commissioner of the imperial clan Zong Xu said: "The great river overflows and breaches because the channel has silted up and cannot take the water.
translations.idiomatic: Henan military commissioner Zong Xu of the imperial clan said: "The Yellow River breaches because the bed is choked with silt and will not hold the flow.

sentences.zh: 今曹、單雖被其患，而兩州本以水利為生，所害農田無幾。

translations.literal: Now Cao and Dan, though stricken, originally lived by waterworks; farmland harmed is slight.
translations.idiomatic: Cao and Dan suffer, yet both counties live by hydraulic labor—the cropland lost is small.

sentences.zh: 今欲河複故道，不惟大費工役，又卒難成功。

translations.literal: Now to wish the river return to the old course is not only greatly costly in labor, but also suddenly hard to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: To force the river back into its old bed would cost enormous labor and still fail at once.

sentences.zh: 縱能塞之，他日霖潦，亦將潰決，則山東河患又非曹、單比也。

translations.literal: Even if it could be blocked, another day of heavy rain and flood would breach again, and then Shandong's river calamity would not compare to Cao and Dan.
translations.idiomatic: Even if sealed, the next cloudburst would burst it again—and Shandong's flood would dwarf what Cao and Dan see now.

sentences.zh: 又沿河數州之地，驟興大役，人心動搖，恐宋人乘間構為邊患。」

translations.literal: Moreover along the river several prefectures, suddenly raising great works, hearts shaken—fearing Song might seize the interval and stir border trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Along the river, sudden mass corvée would shake the people; the Song might use the unrest to raid the frontier."

sentences.zh: 而肅亦言：「新河水六分，舊河水四分，今若塞新河，則二水複合為一。

translations.literal: And Su also said: "New river water six parts, old river water four parts; if now the new river is blocked, then the two waters reunite as one.
translations.idiomatic: Su added: "The new channel carries six-tenths of the flow, the old four. Block the new stream and both become one.

sentences.zh: 如遇漲溢，南決則害于南京，北決'則山東、河北皆被其害。

translations.literal: If meeting flood swell, south breach then harms Nanjing, north breach then Shandong and Hebei all suffer its harm.
translations.idiomatic: At flood stage a southern break would drown Nanjing; a northern break would wash Shandong and Hebei alike.

sentences.zh: 不若李固南築堤以防決溢為便。」

translations.literal: Better south of Ligu build embankment to guard against breach overflow is convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Better to build a dike south of Ligu against breakout—that is the prudent course."

sentences.zh: 尚書省以聞，上從之。

translations.literal: The Secretariat reported; the emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized; the throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 十年三月，拜宗敘為參知政事，上諭之曰：「卿昨為河南統軍時，嘗言黃河堤埽利害，甚合朕意。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 10 Zong Xu was appointed participation councillor; the emperor instructed him: "You yesterday as Henan military commissioner spoke of Yellow River dike and sao harm and benefit, very fitting Our mind.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, year 10: Zong Xu became participation councillor. The emperor told him: "As Henan commander you once laid out the Yellow River dikes and sao—exactly what I needed.

sentences.zh: 朕每念百姓凡有差調，吏互為奸，若不早計而迫期征斂，則民增十倍之費。

translations.literal: We every think of the people—whenever there is corvée, clerks cheat one another; if not planned early but forced collection at deadline, the people pay tenfold the cost.
translations.idiomatic: I think constantly of the people: every levy breeds clerkish fraud; wait until the deadline and the cost multiplies tenfold.

sentences.zh: 然其所征之物，或委積經年，至腐朽不可複用，使吾民數十萬之財，皆為棄物，此害非細。

translations.literal: Yet what is collected may be piled years until rotten and unusable again, making Our people's wealth of hundreds of thousands all waste—this harm is not slight.
translations.idiomatic: What they seize often rots in storehouses for years—tens of thousands in wealth turned to trash. That harm is not small.

sentences.zh: 卿既參朝政，凡類此者皆當革其弊，擇所利而行之。」

translations.literal: You now join court governance; wherever like this, all should reform its abuses and choose what profits to execute."
translations.idiomatic: You sit in council now—root out such abuses and keep only what truly serves the realm."

sentences.zh: 十一年，河決王村，南京孟、衛州界多被其害。

translations.literal: In year 11 the river breached at Wangcun; Nanjing, Meng, and Weizhou borders mostly suffered.
translations.idiomatic: Year 11 the river broke at Wangcun; Nanjing and the Meng and Wei frontier bore the brunt.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月，尚書省奏：「檢視官言，水東南行，其勢甚大。

translations.literal: In the first month of year 12, the Secretariat memorialized, "The inspection officers say the water is moving southeast, and its force is very great.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 12, the Secretariat memorialized, "The inspection officers say the water is moving southeast, and its force is very great.

sentences.zh: 可自河陰廣武山循河而東，至原武、陽武、東明等縣孟、衛等州增築堤岸，日役夫萬一千，期以六十日畢。」

translations.literal: From Guangwu Mountain in Heyin, one may follow the river east to Yuanwu, Yangwu, Dongming, and the Meng and Wei prefectures, adding to and building up the dike banks; employ eleven thousand laborers each day, with a deadline of sixty days for completion."
translations.idiomatic: From Guangwu Mountain in Heyin, one may follow the river east to Yuanwu, Yangwu, Dongming, and the Meng and Wei prefectures, adding to and building up the dike banks; employ eleven thousand laborers each day, with a deadline of sixty days for completion."

sentences.zh: 詔遣太府少監張九思、同知南京留守事紇石烈邈小字阿補孫監護工作。

translations.literal: An edict sent Palace Storehouse vice director Zhang Jiusi and Nanjing deputy defender Wanyan Yaosun (courtesy name Aibusun) to supervise the work.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Zhang Jiusi of the Palace Storehouse and Nanjing deputy defender Wanyan Yaosun (courtesy Aibusun) to supervise.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，以尚書省請修孟津、滎澤、崇福埽堤以備水患，上乃命雄武以下八埽並以類從事。

translations.literal: In the third month of year 13, because the Secretariat requested repair of Mengjin, Yingze, and Chongfu sao dikes against water calamity, the emperor then ordered Xiongwu and the seven sao below to follow suit by category.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, year 13: at the Secretariat's request to repair Mengjin, Yingze, and Chongfu sao dikes, the throne ordered Xiongwu and seven sao downstream to do the same.

sentences.zh: 十七年秋七月，大雨，河決白溝。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, year 17, great rain; the river breached at Baigou.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, year 17: heavy rains; the river broke at Baigou.

sentences.zh: 十二月，尚書省奏：「修築河堤，日役夫一萬一千五百，以六十日畢工。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Secretariat memorialized, "For repairing and building the river dikes, employ eleven thousand five hundred laborers each day, and complete the work in sixty days."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Secretariat memorialized, "For repairing and building the river dikes, employ eleven thousand five hundred laborers each day, and complete the work in sixty days."

sentences.zh: 詔以十八年二月一日發六百里內軍夫，並取職官人力之半，餘聽發民夫，以尚書工部郎中張大節、同知南京留守事高蘇董役。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that on the first day of the second month of year 18, within six hundred li, army corvée and half the clerical manpower be levied; the rest might be civilian corvée; Works Bureau director Zhang Dajie and Nanjing deputy defender Gao Su would direct the labor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 18, first day: corvée within six hundred li—troops plus half the official staff, the rest civilians—under Zhang Dajie of the Works Bureau and Nanjing deputy Gao Su.

sentences.zh: 先是，祥符縣陳橋鎮之東至陳留潘崗，黃河堤道四十餘里以縣官攝其事，南京有司言，乞專設埽官，十九年九月，乃設京埽巡河官一員。

translations.literal: Earlier, from east of Chenqiao town in Xiangfu county to Pan hillock in Chenliu, forty-odd li of Yellow River dike road were handled by county officials; Nanjing authorities asked a dedicated sao officer; in the ninth month of year 19 one Jing sao river-patrol officer was set.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, forty-odd li of Yellow River dike from Chenqiao in Xiangfu east to Pan hillock in Chenliu had been run by county deputies; Nanjing asked for a dedicated sao officer—in the ninth month of year 19 a Jing sao patrol officer was appointed.

sentences.zh: 二十年，河決衛州及廷津京東埽，彌漫至於歸德府。

translations.literal: In year 20 the river breached Weizhou and Tingjin Jingdong sao, spreading to Guide Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Year 20: breaches at Weizhou and Tingjin Jingdong sao flooded as far as Guide Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 檢視官南京副留守石抹輝者言：「河水因今秋霖潦暴漲，遂失故道，勢益南行。」

translations.literal: Inspector Nanjing deputy defender Shimo Hui said: "River water because this autumn's rain flood swelled violently, then lost the old course, force increasingly running south."
translations.idiomatic: Inspector Shimo Hui, Nanjing deputy defender, reported: "Autumn floods drove the river out of its old bed; the current is shoving ever farther south."

sentences.zh: 宰臣以聞。

translations.literal: Chancellors reported.
translations.idiomatic: The chancellors memorialized.

sentences.zh: 乃自衛州埽下接歸德府南北兩岸增築堤以捍湍怒，計工一百七十九萬六千餘，日役夫二萬四千餘，期以七十日畢工。

translations.literal: Then from Weizhou sao down connecting Guide Prefecture north and south both banks, raise dikes to resist turbulent rage; labor reckoned 1,796,000-odd, daily corvée twenty-four thousand-odd, term seventy days to finish.
translations.idiomatic: They raised dikes from Weizhou sao down along both banks of Guide—1,796,000-odd work units, 24,000 laborers a day, seventy days.

sentences.zh: 遂於歸德府創設巡河官一員，埽兵二百人，且詔頻役夫之地與免今年稅賦。

translations.literal: Then at Guide Prefecture one river-patrol officer was newly set, sao troops two hundred; also an edict that places frequently levying corvée were exempted this year's tax and levies.
translations.idiomatic: Guide gained a new patrol officer and two hundred sao troops; corvée districts were excused that year's taxes.

sentences.zh: 二十一年十月，以河移故道，命築堤以備。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of year 21, because the river shifted the old course, an order to build dikes against it.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, year 21: the river had left its old bed—orders to build protective dikes.

sentences.zh: 二十六年八月，河決衛州堤，壞其城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of year 26 the river breached Weizhou dike and destroyed its city.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, year 26: the river broke Weizhou's dike and wrecked the city.

sentences.zh: 上命戶部侍郎王寂、都水少監王汝嘉馳傳措畫備禦。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Revenue vice director Wang Ji and Directorate of Waterways vice director Wang Rujia to rush by post to plan defenses.
translations.idiomatic: The throne sent Wang Ji of Revenue and Wang Rujia of the Directorate of Waterways post-haste to organize defenses.

sentences.zh: 而寂視被災之民不為拯救，乃專集眾以網魚取官物為事，民甚怨嫉。

translations.literal: But Ji, viewing the stricken people, did not save them; he only gathered crowds to net fish for government goods, and the people greatly resented.
translations.idiomatic: Ji ignored the drowning counties and set men to net fish for the treasury; resentment boiled up.

sentences.zh: 上聞而惡之。

translations.literal: The emperor heard and detested it.
translations.idiomatic: Word reached the throne; the emperor was disgusted.

sentences.zh: 既而，河勢氾濫及大名。

translations.literal: Soon after, river force flooded and overflowed as far as Daming.
translations.idiomatic: The flood soon spread to Daming.

sentences.zh: 上於是遣戶部尚書劉瑋往行工部事，從宜規畫，黜寂為蔡州防禦使。

translations.literal: The emperor then sent Revenue director Liu Wei to act Works affairs, act as expedient, and demoted Ji to Caizhou defender.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Liu Wei of Revenue to handle Works matters with full discretion and demoted Ji to defender of Caizhou.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，上謂宰臣曰：「朕聞亡宋河防一步置一人，可添設河防軍數。」

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, the emperor told the chancellors: "We hear the fallen Song placed one man every step on river defense—river-defense troops may be added."
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month: the emperor told his ministers, "I hear the fallen Song posted one man every pace along the dikes—we should enlarge the river-defense corps."

sentences.zh: 它日，又曰：「比聞河水泛溢，民罹其害者，貲產皆空。

translations.literal: Another day he also said: "Recently We hear river water overflowed, people suffering its harm—all property empty.
translations.idiomatic: Another day he said: "The floods have emptied people's stores—why

sentences.zh: 今複遣官于被災路分推排，何耶？」

translations.literal: Now again sending officials on stricken routes to assess—why?"
translations.idiomatic: send assessors down the disaster routes to squeeze more?"

sentences.zh: 右丞張汝霖曰：「今推排者皆非被災之處。」

translations.literal: Right vice director Zhang Rulin said: "Those now assessed are all not stricken places."
translations.idiomatic: Vice director Zhang Rulin said: "The assessments aren't even hitting the flooded districts."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「雖然，必其鄰道也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Although so, surely neighboring circuits.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Even so—they border the water.

sentences.zh: 既鄰水而居，豈無驚擾遷避者乎？

translations.literal: Already neighboring water and dwelling, how without alarm, disturbance, flight, and avoidance?
translations.idiomatic: Live beside the river and nobody flees or panics?

sentences.zh: 計其貲產，豈有餘哉！

translations.literal: Reckoning their property, how could there be surplus!
translations.idiomatic: Count their goods—what surplus remains?

sentences.zh: 尚何推排為。」

translations.literal: Still why assess."
translations.idiomatic: Why assess at all?"

sentences.zh: 十一月，又謂宰臣曰：「河未決衛州時嘗有言者，既決之後，有司何故不令朕知。」

translations.literal: In the eleventh month he again told the chancellors: "Before the river breached Weizhou there were those who spoke; after it breached, why did officials not let Us know."
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: "Before Weizhou broke, someone warned me. After the breach, why was I kept in the dark?"

sentences.zh: 命詢其故。

translations.literal: An order to inquire the reason.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered an inquiry.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月，尚書省言：「鄭州河陰縣聖後廟，前代河水為患，屢禱有應，嘗加封號廟額。

translations.literal: In the spring, first month of year 27, the Secretariat said, "At the temple of the Sacred Queen in Heyin county, Zhengzhou, in former generations the river water caused disasters, and repeated prayers there received responses; titles and a temple plaque were once added.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring, first month of year 27, the Secretariat said, "At the temple of the Sacred Queen in Heyin county, Zhengzhou, in former generations the river water caused disasters, and repeated prayers there received responses; titles and a temple plaque were once added.

sentences.zh: 今因禱祈，河遂安流，乞加褒贈。」

translations.literal: Now, because prayers were offered, the river has accordingly flowed peacefully; we request added praise and grants."
translations.idiomatic: Now, because prayers were offered, the river has accordingly flowed peacefully; we request added praise and grants."

sentences.zh: 上從其請，特加號曰昭應順濟聖後，廟曰靈德善利之廟。

translations.literal: The emperor followed the request, specially adding title Zhao Ying Shun Ji Sheng Hou, temple Ling De Shan Li zhi Miao.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed, adding the title "Manifest Responsive Smooth-Flowing Sacred Queen" and naming the temple "Temple of Spiritual Virtue and Beneficent Profit."

sentences.zh: 二月，以衛州新鄉縣令張虡、丞唐括唐古出、主簿溫敦偎喝，以河水入城閉塞救護有功，皆遷賞有差。

translations.literal: In the second month, because Weizhou Xinxiang magistrate Zhang Xu, aide Tangut Tangguchu, and registrar Wendun Weina, for river water entering the city blocking and rescue having merit, all were promoted and rewarded by degree.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: Xinxiang magistrate Zhang Xu, aide Tangut Tangguchu, and registrar Wendun Weina earned graded promotions for sealing the breach when the river drove into the city.

sentences.zh: 御史台言：「自來沿河京、府、州、縣官坐視管內河防缺壤，特不介意。

translations.literal: The Censorate said: "From old, along-river capital, prefecture, and county officials sat viewing within their jurisdiction river-defense gaps and breaches, especially not minding.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate said: "River officials have long watched gaps in the dikes inside their jurisdictions and shrugged.

sentences.zh: 若令沿河京、府、州縣長貳官皆于名銜管勾河防事，如任內規措有方能禦大患，或守護不謹以致疏虞，臨時聞奏，以議賞罰。」

translations.literal: If ordered that along-river capital, prefecture, and county chief and vice officials all in their name titles oversee river-defense affairs—if within term planning had ability and could ward great calamity, or guarding not carefully and causing negligence, reported at the time to discuss reward and punishment."
translations.idiomatic: Put river defense in the chief and vice magistrates' titles: reward those who hold a breach; punish negligence reported in time."

sentences.zh: 上從之，仍命每歲將泛之時，令工部官一員沿河檢視。

translations.literal: The emperor followed it, still ordering each year when floods approach, one Works Bureau official to inspect along the river.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed and ordered a Works Bureau inspector along the river each flood season.

sentences.zh: 於是以南京府及所屬延津、封丘、祥符、開封、陳留、胙城、杞縣、長垣、歸德府及所屬宋城、甯陵、虞城，河南府及孟津，河中府及河東，懷州河內、武陟，同州朝邑，衛州汲、新鄉、獲嘉、徐州彭城、蕭、豐，孟州河陽、溫，鄭州河陰、滎澤、原武、汜水，浚州衛，陝州閿鄉、湖城、靈寶，曹州濟陰，滑州白馬，睢州襄邑，滕州沛，單州單父，解州平陸，開州濮陽，濟州嘉祥、金鄉、鄆城，四府、十六州之長貳皆提舉河防事，四十四縣之令佐皆管勾河防事。

translations.literal: Then Nanjing Prefecture and subordinates Yanjin, Fengqiu, Xiangfu, Kaifeng, Chenliu, Zuo, Qi, Changyuan, Guide Prefecture and subordinates Songcheng, Ningling, Yucheng, Henan Prefecture and Mengjin, Hezhong Prefecture and Hedong, Huaizhou Henei and Wuzhi, Tongzhou Chaoyi, Weizhou Ji and Xinxiang and Huojia, Xuzhou Pengcheng and Xiao and Feng, Mengzhou Heyang and Wen, Zhengzhou Heyin and Yingze and Yuanwu and Sishui, Xunzhou Wei, Shanzhou Min, Hucheng, Lingbao, Caozhou Jiyin, Huazhou Baima, Suizhou Xiangyi, Tengzhou Pei, Danzhou Danfu, Jiezhou Pinglu, Kaizhou Puyang, Jizhou Jiaxiang and Jinxiang and Yancheng—four prefectures, sixteen zhou chiefs and vices all commissioned river defense; forty-four counties' magistrates and aides all oversaw river defense.
translations.idiomatic: The order covered Nanjing Prefecture and its counties Yanjin, Fengqiu, Xiangfu, Kaifeng, Chenliu, Zuocheng, Qi, and Changyuan; Guide Prefecture and its counties Songcheng, Ningling, and Yucheng; Henan Prefecture and Mengjin; Hezhong Prefecture and Hedong; Henei and Wuzhi under Huaizhou; Chaoyi under Tongzhou; Ji, Xinxiang, and Huojia under Weizhou; Pengcheng, Xiao, and Feng under Xuzhou; Heyang and Wen under Mengzhou; Heyin, Yingze, Yuanwu, and Sishui under Zhengzhou; Wei under Xunzhou; Minxiang, Hucheng, and Lingbao under Shanzhou; Jiyin under Caozhou; Baima under Huazhou; Xiangyi under Suizhou; Pei under Tengzhou; Danfu under Danzhou; Pinglu under Jiezhou; Puyang under Kaizhou; and Jiaxiang, Jinxiang, and Yancheng under Jizhou. The chiefs and deputies of four prefectures and sixteen zhou were all made river-defense commissioners, and the magistrates and aides of forty-four counties were all made river-defense overseers.

sentences.zh: 初，衛州為河水所壞，乃命增築蘇門，遷其州治。

translations.literal: Earlier, Weizhou was destroyed by river water; then an order to raise Sumen and move its prefectural seat.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the flood had wrecked Weizhou; the court had ordered Sumen raised and the seat moved.

sentences.zh: 至二十八年，水息，居民稍還，皆不樂遷。

translations.literal: By year 28 the water had eased; residents gradually returned, all unwilling to move.
translations.idiomatic: By year 28 the water had fallen back; people drifted home and refused relocation.

sentences.zh: 於是遣大理少卿康元弼按視之。

translations.literal: Then Grand Court of Review vice director Kang Yuanbi was sent to inspect on site.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Kang Yuanbi of the Grand Court of Review to inspect on site.

sentences.zh: 元弼還奏：「舊州民複業者甚眾，且南使驛道館舍所在，向以不為水備，以故被害。

translations.literal: Yuanbi returned and memorialized: "Old prefecture people returning to livelihood are very many; moreover the southern envoy post road lodge is there—before not prepared for water, therefore suffered harm.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanbi reported: "Many have reopened the old town; the southern envoy post stands there—lack of flood prep caused the ruin.

sentences.zh: 若但修其堤之薄缺者，可以無虞，比之遷治，所省數倍，不若從其民情，修治舊城為便。」

translations.literal: If only repair the dike's thin gaps, can be without worry; compared to moving the seat, savings severalfold—better follow the people's feeling and repair the old city."
translations.idiomatic: Patch the thin spots in the dike and we need not fear—far cheaper than moving the seat. Honor the people and rebuild the old walls."

sentences.zh: 乃不遷州，仍敕自今河防官司怠慢失備者，皆重抵以罪。

translations.literal: Then the seat was not moved; still an edict that from now river-defense offices slack and unprepared would all be heavily punished.
translations.idiomatic: The seat stayed put; slack river officials would face heavy punishment from then on.

sentences.zh: 二十九年五月，河溢于曹州小堤之北。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of year 29 the river overflowed north of Caozhou's small dike.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, year 29: the river topped the small dike north of Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 六月，上諭旨有司曰：「比聞五月二十八日河溢，而所報文字如此稽滯。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the emperor instructed the authorities: "Recently We hear on the twenty-eighth day of the fifth month the river overflowed, yet the report text is so delayed.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: "I hear the river topped on the twenty-eighth of the fifth month—yet your report crawled in.

sentences.zh: 水事最急，功不可緩，稍緩時頃，則難固護矣。」

translations.literal: Water affairs are most urgent; work cannot be slow—slightly slow in time and then hard to solidify and guard."
translations.idiomatic: Water work brooks no delay—wait a moment and the levee is lost."

sentences.zh: 十二月，工部言：「營築河堤，用工六百八萬餘，就用埽兵軍夫外，有四百三十余萬工當用民夫。」

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Ministry of Works said, "Building the river dikes will use more than 6,080,000 units of labor; after using sao troops and military laborers, more than 4,300,000 units should be supplied by civilian laborers."
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Ministry of Works said, "Building the river dikes will use more than 6,080,000 units of labor; after using sao troops and military laborers, more than 4,300,000 units should be supplied by civilian laborers."

sentences.zh: 遂詔命去役所五百里州、府差顧，於不差夫之地均征顧錢，驗物力科之。

translations.literal: Then an edict ordered prefectures within five hundred li of the works to hire labor; where corvée was not levied, spread hire money evenly; assess by property power.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures within five hundred li were to hire labor; where no corvée was levied, hire fees were spread by property assessment.

sentences.zh: 每工錢百五十交外，日支官錢五十文，米升半。

translations.literal: Each work unit besides one hundred fifty cash wages, daily issued official cash fifty wen, rice one and a half sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Each work unit paid 150 cash plus fifty wen and one and a half sheng of rice per day.

sentences.zh: 仍命彰化軍節度使內族裔、都水少監大齡壽提控五百人往來彈壓。

translations.literal: Still ordered Zhanghua Army military commissioner imperial clansman and Directorate of Waterways vice director Daling Shou to direct five hundred men coming and going to suppress.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial clansman Daling Shou, Zhanghua Army commissioner and vice director of waterways, was sent with five hundred men to keep order.

sentences.zh: 先是，河南路提刑司言：「沿河居民多困乏逃移，蓋以河防差役煩重故也。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Henan Route judicial commissioner had said, "Residents along the river are often exhausted and flee, probably because river-defense labor assignments are heavy and troublesome.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, the Henan Route judicial commissioner had said, "Residents along the river are often exhausted and flee, probably because river-defense labor assignments are heavy and troublesome.

sentences.zh: 竊惟禦水患者，不過堤埽，若土功從實計料，薪槁樁杙以時征斂，亦複何難。

translations.literal: I privately think that defense against water disasters is no more than dikes and sao works; if earthwork is honestly calculated and materials such as brushwood, straw, piles, and stakes are levied at the proper time, what difficulty is there?
translations.idiomatic: I privately think that defense against water disasters is no more than dikes and sao works; if earthwork is honestly calculated and materials such as brushwood, straw, piles, and stakes are levied at the proper time, what difficulty is there?

sentences.zh: 今春築堤，都水監初料取土甚近，及其興工乃遠數倍，人夫懼不及程，貴價買土，一隊之間多至千貫。

translations.literal: This spring, when the dike was built, the Directorate of Waterways at first estimated that soil would be taken from very near by; when work began, it was several times farther away, and the laborers, afraid of missing the quota, bought soil at high prices, in one team often reaching a thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: This spring, when the dike was built, the Directorate of Waterways at first estimated that soil would be taken from very near by; when work began, it was several times farther away, and the laborers, afraid of missing the quota, bought soil at high prices, in one team often reaching a thousand strings.

sentences.zh: 又許州初科薪槁十八萬餘束，既而又配四萬四千，是皆常歲必用之物，農隙均科則易輸納。

translations.literal: Also, Xuzhou was at first assessed more than 180,000 bundles of brushwood and straw, and later was assigned another 44,000. These are all things used in ordinary years; if assessed evenly during the farming slack, they are easy to deliver.
translations.idiomatic: Also, Xuzhou was at first assessed more than 180,000 bundles of brushwood and straw, and later was assigned another 44,000. These are all things used in ordinary years; if assessed evenly during the farming slack, they are easy to deliver.

sentences.zh: 自今堤埽興工，乞令本監以實計度，量一歲所用物料，驗數折稅，或令和買，於冬月分為三限輸納為便。」

translations.literal: From now on, when work is begun on dikes and sao works, I request that this Directorate calculate and measure honestly, estimate the materials used in one year, commute them according to the numbers into tax, or have them bought by negotiated purchase, and deliver them in three installments during the winter months. This would be convenient."
translations.idiomatic: From now on, when work is begun on dikes and sao works, I request that this Directorate calculate and measure honestly, estimate the materials used in one year, commute them according to the numbers into tax, or have them bought by negotiated purchase, and deliver them in three installments during the winter months. This would be convenient."

sentences.zh: 詔尚書省詳議以聞。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Secretariat to deliberate in detail and report.
translations.idiomatic: The throne told the Secretariat to deliberate and report.

sentences.zh: 明昌元年春正月，尚書省奏：「臣等以為，自今凡興工役，先量負土遠近，增築高卑，定功立限，榜諭使人先知，無令增加力役。

translations.literal: In the spring, first month of Mingchang 1, the Secretariat memorialized, "Your servants believe that from now on, whenever labor projects are begun, the distance for carrying earth, the height of added construction, the labor quota, and the deadline should first be measured and fixed, and notices should be posted so people know in advance, without allowing labor demands to be increased.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring, first month of Mingchang 1, the Secretariat memorialized, "Your servants believe that from now on, whenever labor projects are begun, the distance for carrying earth, the height of added construction, the labor quota, and the deadline should first be measured and fixed, and notices should be posted so people know in advance, without allowing labor demands to be increased.

sentences.zh: 並河防所用物色，委都水監每歲於八月以前，先拘籍舊貯物外實闕之數，及次年春工多寡，移報轉運司計置，於冬三月分限輸納。

translations.literal: As for the items used for river defense, the Directorate of Waterways should be entrusted each year, before the eighth month, first to register the existing stored materials and the actual shortfall, as well as the amount of work for the following spring, and report it to the Transport Commission for arrangement, with delivery divided into deadlines across the three winter months.
translations.idiomatic: As for the items used for river defense, the Directorate of Waterways should be entrusted each year, before the eighth month, first to register the existing stored materials and the actual shortfall, as well as the amount of work for the following spring, and report it to the Transport Commission for arrangement, with delivery divided into deadlines across the three winter months.

sentences.zh: 如水勢不常，夏秋暴漲危急，則用相鄰埽分防備之物，不足，則複於所近州縣和買。

translations.literal: If the water force is irregular and sudden rises in summer and autumn create danger and urgency, then use the defense materials of neighboring sao divisions; if they are insufficient, then again buy by negotiated purchase from nearby prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: If the water force is irregular and sudden rises in summer and autumn create danger and urgency, then use the defense materials of neighboring sao divisions; if they are insufficient, then again buy by negotiated purchase from nearby prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 然複慮人戶道塗泥淖，艱於運納，止依稅內科折他物，更為增價，當官支付，違者並論如律，仍令所屬提刑司正官一員馳驛監視體究，如此則役作有程，而河不失備。」

translations.literal: Yet because households may find roads muddy and transport difficult, simply follow the taxes by assessing other materials in commutation, further adding to the price and paying it through the office. Violators are all to be prosecuted according to law, and one chief officer from the subordinate judicial commissioner's office is to ride by post to supervise and investigate. In this way labor works will have schedules, and the river will not lose its defenses."
translations.idiomatic: Yet because households may find roads muddy and transport difficult, simply follow the taxes by assessing other materials in commutation, further adding to the price and paying it through the office. Violators are all to be prosecuted according to law, and one chief officer from the subordinate judicial commissioner's office is to ride by post to supervise and investigate. In this way labor works will have schedules, and the river will not lose its defenses."

sentences.zh: 制可之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月，尚書省奏：「河平軍節度使王汝嘉等言：'大河南岸舊有分流河口，如可疏導，足泄其勢，及長堤以北恐亦有可以歸納排瀹之處，乞委官視之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of year 4, the Secretariat memorialized, "Wang Rujia and others, military commissioner of Heping Army, say: On the south bank of the Great River there were formerly diversion mouths; if they can be dredged and guided, they will be enough to release its force. North of the long dike, perhaps there are also places where water can be received, drained, and cleared. We request that officials be assigned to inspect them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of year 4, the Secretariat memorialized, "Wang Rujia and others, military commissioner of Heping Army, say: On the south bank of the Great River there were formerly diversion mouths; if they can be dredged and guided, they will be enough to release its force. North of the long dike, perhaps there are also places where water can be received, drained, and cleared. We request that officials be assigned to inspect them.

sentences.zh: 濟北埽以北宜創起月堤。

translations.literal: North of Jibei sao, moon dikes should be newly built.
translations.idiomatic: North of Jibei sao, moon dikes should be newly built.

sentences.zh: '臣等以為宜從所言。

translations.literal: Your servants believe that what they say should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: Your servants believe that what they say should be followed.

sentences.zh: 其本監官皆以諳練河防故注以是職，當使從汝嘉等同往相視，庶免異議。

translations.literal: All the officials of this Directorate were appointed to these posts because they were practiced in river defense, and should be sent with Rujia and the others to inspect, so as to avoid conflicting opinions.
translations.idiomatic: All the officials of this Directorate were appointed to these posts because they were practiced in river defense, and should be sent with Rujia and the others to inspect, so as to avoid conflicting opinions.

sentences.zh: 如大河南北必不能開挑歸納，其月堤宜依所料興修。」

translations.literal: If north and south of the Great River it is certainly impossible to open channels, dredge, receive, and guide the water, then the moon dikes should be built according to the estimate."
translations.idiomatic: If north and south of the Great River it is certainly impossible to open channels, dredge, receive, and guide the water, then the moon dikes should be built according to the estimate."

sentences.zh: 上從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 十二月，敕都水監官提控修築黃河堤，及令大名府差正千戶一員，部甲軍二百人彈壓勾當。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered the officials of the Directorate of Waterways to supervise repairs and construction of the Yellow River dikes, and ordered Daming prefecture to assign one regular chiliarch to command two hundred armored soldiers for enforcement and management.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, an edict ordered the officials of the Directorate of Waterways to supervise repairs and construction of the Yellow River dikes, and ordered Daming prefecture to assign one regular chiliarch to command two hundred armored soldiers for enforcement and management.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月，尚書省奏：「都水監丞田櫟同本監官講議黃河利害，嘗以狀上言，前代每遇古堤南決，多經南、北清河分流，南清河北下有枯河數道，河水流其中者長至七八分，北清河乃濟水故道，可容三二分而已。

translations.literal: In the spring, first month of year 5, the Secretariat memorialized, "Tian Li, assistant director of the Directorate of Waterways, together with officials of this Directorate, discussed the benefits and harms of the Yellow River and once submitted a statement saying: In former generations, whenever the old dikes breached to the south, the flow often divided through the South and North Qing Rivers. Below the South Qing River there are several dry channels, and when river water flows among them it can take seventy or eighty percent; the North Qing River is the old course of the Ji River and can contain only twenty or thirty percent.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring, first month of year 5, the Secretariat memorialized, "Tian Li, assistant director of the Directorate of Waterways, together with officials of this Directorate, discussed the benefits and harms of the Yellow River and once submitted a statement saying: In former generations, whenever the old dikes breached to the south, the flow often divided through the South and North Qing Rivers. Below the South Qing River there are several dry channels, and when river water flows among them it can take seventy or eighty percent; the North Qing River is the old course of the Ji River and can contain only twenty or thirty percent.

sentences.zh: 令河水趨北，齧長堤而流者十餘處，而堤外率多積水，恐難依元料增修長堤與創築月堤也。

translations.literal: Now the river water tends northward, gnawing and flowing against the long dike in more than ten places, and outside the dike there is generally much standing water; I fear it will be difficult to follow the original estimate in raising the long dike and newly building moon dikes.
translations.idiomatic: Now the river water tends northward, gnawing and flowing against the long dike in more than ten places, and outside the dike there is generally much standing water; I fear it will be difficult to follow the original estimate in raising the long dike and newly building moon dikes.

sentences.zh: 可於北岸牆村決河入梁山濼故道，依舊作南、北兩清河分流。

translations.literal: One may breach the river at Qiang village on the north bank, send it into the old course of Liangshan Marsh, and divide it as before into the South and North Qing Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: One may breach the river at Qiang village on the north bank, send it into the old course of Liangshan Marsh, and divide it as before into the South and North Qing Rivers.

sentences.zh: 然北清河舊堤歲久不完，當立年限增築大堤，而梁山故道多有屯田軍戶，亦宜遷徙。

translations.literal: But the old dikes of the North Qing River have not been complete for many years, so a term of years should be established to build up a great dike, and the military farming households in the old course of Liangshan should also be moved.
translations.idiomatic: But the old dikes of the North Qing River have not been complete for many years, so a term of years should be established to build up a great dike, and the military farming households in the old course of Liangshan should also be moved.

sentences.zh: 今擬先于南岸王村、宜村兩處決堤導水，使長堤可以固護，姑宜仍舊，如不能疏導，即依上開決，分為四道，俟見水勢隨宜料理。」

translations.literal: For now, we propose first to breach the dike at Wang village and Yi village on the south bank to guide the water, so that the long dike can be firmly protected and temporarily remain as before. If the water cannot be dredged and guided, then follow the openings stated above, divide it into four channels, and, after observing the water force, manage matters as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: For now, we propose first to breach the dike at Wang village and Yi village on the south bank to guide the water, so that the long dike can be firmly protected and temporarily remain as before. If the water cannot be dredged and guided, then follow the openings stated above, divide it into four channels, and, after observing the water force, manage matters as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 尚書省以櫟等所言與明昌二年劉瑋等所案視利害不同，及令陳言人馮德輿與櫟面對，亦有不合者，送工部議。

translations.literal: The Secretariat said Li and others' words differed from Mingchang 2 Liu Wei and others' on-site harm and benefit inspection; also ordered memorializer Feng Deyu to face Li—also had discrepancies; sent to Works Bureau to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat noted Li's plan clashed with Liu Wei's Mingchang 2 inspection and Feng Deyu's face-to-face review, and referred the dispute to the Works Bureau.

sentences.zh: 複言：「若遽於牆村疏決，緣瀕北清河州縣二十餘處，兩岸連亙千有餘裏，其堤防素不修備，恐所屯軍戶亦卒難徙。

translations.literal: They further said, "If Qiang village is dredged and breached in haste, because there are more than twenty prefectures and counties along the North Qing River and both banks extend for more than a thousand li, their dike defenses have never been repaired and prepared, and I fear the stationed military households will also be difficult to move suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: They further said, "If Qiang village is dredged and breached in haste, because there are more than twenty prefectures and counties along the North Qing River and both banks extend for more than a thousand li, their dike defenses have never been repaired and prepared, and I fear the stationed military households will also be difficult to move suddenly.

sentences.zh: 今歲先于南岸延津縣堤決堤泄水，其北岸長堤自白馬以下，定陶以上，並宜加功築護，庶可以遏將來之患。

translations.literal: This year, first breach the dike of Yanjin county on the south bank to release the water; as for the long dike on the north bank, from Baima down to above Dingtao, all should receive added work and be built and protected, perhaps thereby stopping future disasters.
translations.idiomatic: This year, first breach the dike of Yanjin county on the south bank to release the water; as for the long dike on the north bank, from Baima down to above Dingtao, all should receive added work and be built and protected, perhaps thereby stopping future disasters.

sentences.zh: 若定陶以東三埽棄堤則不必修，止決舊壓河口，引導積水東南行，流堤北張彪、白塔兩河間，礙水軍戶可使遷徙，及梁山濼故道分屯者，亦當預為安置。」

translations.literal: If the three sao east of Dingtao abandon their dikes, there is no need to repair them. Only breach the old pressed river mouths, guide the standing water southeast, and let it flow north of the dike between the Zhangbiao and Baita rivers. The military households in the way of the water can be moved, and those divided among the old course of Liangshan Marsh should also be settled in advance."
translations.idiomatic: If the three sao east of Dingtao abandon their dikes, there is no need to repair them. Only breach the old pressed river mouths, guide the standing water southeast, and let it flow north of the dike between the Zhangbiao and Baita rivers. The military households in the way of the water can be moved, and those divided among the old course of Liangshan Marsh should also be settled in advance."

sentences.zh: 宰臣奏曰：「若遽從櫟等所擬，恐既更張，利害非細。

translations.literal: The chief ministers memorialized, "If Tian Li and the others' proposal is followed suddenly, I fear that once changes are made, the benefits and harms will be no small matter.
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers memorialized, "If Tian Li and the others' proposal is followed suddenly, I fear that once changes are made, the benefits and harms will be no small matter.

sentences.zh: 比召河平軍節度使王汝嘉同計議，先差幹濟官兩員行戶工部事覆視之，同則就令計實用工物、量州縣遠近以調丁夫，其督趣春工官即充今歲守漲，及與本監官同議經久之利。」

translations.literal: Recently we summoned Wang Rujia, military commissioner of Heping Army, to deliberate together. First send two capable officials acting for the Ministries of Revenue and Works to inspect it again. If they agree, then have them calculate the actual labor and materials needed, measure the distance of the prefectures and counties in order to levy adult laborers, have the officials supervising the spring works also serve as this year's flood guards, and deliberate with the officials of this Directorate on lasting benefit."
translations.idiomatic: Recently we summoned Wang Rujia, military commissioner of Heping Army, to deliberate together. First send two capable officials acting for the Ministries of Revenue and Works to inspect it again. If they agree, then have them calculate the actual labor and materials needed, measure the distance of the prefectures and counties in order to levy adult laborers, have the officials supervising the spring works also serve as this year's flood guards, and deliberate with the officials of this Directorate on lasting benefit."

sentences.zh: 詔以知大名府事內族裔、尚書戶部郎中李敬義充行戶工部事，以參知政事胥持國都提控。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Daming prefect imperial clansman and Revenue director Li Jingyi to act traveling Works affairs, with participation councillor Xu Chiguo as overall director.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingyi, imperial clansman and prefect of Daming, was named acting Works commissioner; Xu Chiguo, participation councillor, directed the effort.

sentences.zh: 又奏差德州防禦使李獻可、尚書戶部郎中焦旭于山東當水所經州縣築護城堤，及北清河兩岸舊有堤處別率丁夫修築，亦就令講究河防之計。

translations.literal: Also memorialized dispatching Dezhou defender Li Xiankai and Revenue director Jiao Xu to Shandong water-route prefectures to build protective city dikes, and at North Qing both banks' old dike places separately levy corvée to repair—also charged to discuss river-defense plans.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xiankai of Dezhou and Jiao Xu of Revenue were sent to raise city dikes along Shandong's flood path and repair North Qing levees while studying long-term defense.

sentences.zh: 他日，上以宋閻士良所述《黃河利害》一帙，付參知政事馬琪曰：「此書所言亦有可用者，今以賜卿。」

translations.literal: Another day, the emperor because Song Yan Shiliang's narrated Yellow River harm and benefit one fascicle, gave participation councillor Ma Qi, saying: "This book's words also have usable ones—now given to you."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor handed Ma Qi a fascicle on Yellow River policy by the Song writer Yan Shiliang: "Some of this may be useful."

sentences.zh: 二月，上諭平章政事守貞曰：「王汝嘉、田櫟專管河防，此國家之重事也。

translations.literal: In the second month the emperor instructed Grand Councillor Shouzhen: "Wang Rujia and Tian Li solely manage river defense—this is the state's weighty affair.
translations.idiomatic: Second month: the emperor told Grand Councillor Shouzhen, "Rujia and Li own the river works—a matter of state weight.

sentences.zh: 朕比問其曾于南岸行視否？」

translations.literal: We recently asked whether they had inspected the south bank?"
translations.idiomatic: I asked if they had walked the south bank."

sentences.zh: 乃稱：'未也。

translations.literal: They said: "Not yet."
translations.idiomatic: They said, "Not yet."

sentences.zh: '又問水決能行南岸乎？

translations.literal: Again asked whether water breach could run the south bank?
translations.idiomatic: Could a breach send the river south?

sentences.zh: 又雲：「不可知。

translations.literal: Again said: "It cannot be known.
translations.idiomatic: Again he said: "We cannot know.

sentences.zh: 且水趨北久矣，自去歲便當經畫，今不稱職如是耶！

translations.literal: Moreover, the water has long tended north; planning should have been done from last year—how can they be so incompetent now!
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the water has long tended north; planning should have been done last year. How can they be so incompetent now!

sentences.zh: 可諭旨令往盡心固護，無致失備，及講究所以經久之計。

translations.literal: An edict may be sent ordering them to go, devote all their hearts to firm protection, avoid any failure of preparation, and investigate plans for what will last.
translations.idiomatic: An edict may be sent ordering them to go and devote all their hearts to firm protection, avoid any failure of preparation, and investigate plans that will endure.

sentences.zh: 稍涉違慢，當並治罪。」

translations.literal: If they are even slightly negligent or slow, they should all be punished."
translations.idiomatic: If they are even slightly negligent or slow, they should all be punished."

sentences.zh: 三月，行省並行戶工部及都水監官各言河防利害事。

translations.literal: The Directorate originally planned at south bank Wangcun and Yicun two places to open and guide river force—because north-coming water force at Yicun dike somewhat slow, only Wangcun bank upward several li lying roll could be opened as one river, and without offending cities and villages.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate favored breaching at Wangcun—several li of lying roll above Wangcun could be cut without hitting towns, while Yicun looked slower.

sentences.zh: 都水監元擬于南岸王村、宜村兩處開導河勢，緣北來水勢去宜村堤稍緩，唯王村岸向上數裏臥卷，可以開決作一河，且無所犯之城市村落。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Waterways originally proposed opening and guiding the river force at Wang village and Yi village on the south bank. Because the northern water force reaches the Yi village dike somewhat more slowly, only the bank several li above Wang village curls inward and can be opened into one river, and it would not violate any walled town or village.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Waterways originally proposed opening and guiding the river force at Wang village and Yi village on the south bank. Because the northern water force reaches the Yi village dike somewhat more slowly, only the bank several li above Wang village curls inward and can be opened into one river, and it would not violate any walled town or village.

sentences.zh: 又擬於北岸牆村疏決，依舊分作兩清河入梁山故道，北清河兩岸素有小堤不完，複當築大堤。

translations.literal: They also proposed dredging and breaching at Qiang village on the north bank, dividing the water as before into the two Qing Rivers and sending it into the old course of Liangshan; the small dikes on both banks of the North Qing River had long been incomplete, so a great dike should again be built.
translations.idiomatic: They also proposed dredging and breaching at Qiang village on the north bank, dividing the water as before into the two Qing Rivers and sending it into the old course of Liangshan; the small dikes on both banks of the North Qing River had long been incomplete, so a great dike should again be built.

sentences.zh: 尚書省謂：「以黃河之水勢，若於牆村決注，則山東州縣膏腴之地及諸鹽場必被淪溺。

translations.literal: The Secretariat said, "Given the force of the Yellow River, if it is breached and poured through Qiang village, then the fertile lands of Shandong prefectures and counties and the various salt works will certainly be drowned.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said, "Given the force of the Yellow River, if it is breached and poured through Qiang village, then the fertile lands of Shandong prefectures and counties and the various salt works will certainly be drowned.

sentences.zh: 設使修築壞堤，而又吞納不盡，功役至重，虛困山東之民，非徙無益，而又害之也。

translations.literal: Suppose damaged dikes are repaired and still cannot contain it all: the labor would be extremely heavy, and it would empty and exhaust the people of Shandong. This would not merely lack benefit; it would harm them.
translations.idiomatic: Suppose damaged dikes are repaired and still cannot contain it all: the labor would be extremely heavy, and it would empty and exhaust the people of Shandong. This would not merely lack benefit; it would harm them.

sentences.zh: 況長堤已加護，複于南岸疏決水勢，已寢決河入梁山濼之議，水所經城邑已勸率作護城堤矣，先所修清河舊堤宜遣罷之。

translations.literal: Moreover, the long dike has already been protected, the water force has again been dredged and breached on the south bank, the proposal to breach the river into Liangshan Marsh has already been set aside, and the cities and towns through which the water passes have already been urged and led to build protective city dikes. The earlier repairs to the old Qing River dikes should be ordered stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, the long dike has already been protected, the water force has again been dredged and breached on the south bank, the proposal to breach the river into Liangshan Marsh has already been set aside, and the cities and towns through which the water passes have already been urged and led to build protective city dikes. The earlier repairs to the old Qing River dikes should be ordered stopped.

sentences.zh: 監丞田櫟言定陶以東三埽棄堤不當修，止言：'決舊壓河口以導漸水入堤北張彪、白塔兩河之間，凡當水沖屯田戶須令遷徙。

translations.literal: Assistant director Tian Li says that the three sao east of Dingtao should abandon their dikes and not repair them, and only says: Breach the old pressed river mouths to guide the seeping water into the area north of the dike between the Zhangbiao and Baita rivers, and all military farming households in the path of the water must be moved.
translations.idiomatic: Assistant director Tian Li says that the three sao east of Dingtao should abandon their dikes and not repair them, and only says: Breach the old pressed river mouths to guide the seeping water into the area north of the dike between the Zhangbiao and Baita rivers, and all military farming households in the path of the water must be moved.

sentences.zh: '臣等所見，止當堤前作木岸以備之，其間居人未當遷徙，至夏秋水勢泛溢，權令避之，水落則當各複業，此亦戶工部之所言也。」

translations.literal: In your servants' view, one should only build timber banks before the dikes to prepare against this. The people living there should not be moved yet; when the water force overflows in summer and autumn, temporarily order them to avoid it, and when the water falls, each should return to his livelihood. This is also what the Ministries of Revenue and Works have said."
translations.idiomatic: In your servants' view, one should only build timber banks before the dikes to prepare against this. The people living there should not be moved yet; when the water force overflows in summer and autumn, temporarily order them to avoid it, and when the water falls, each should return to his livelihood. This is also what the Ministries of Revenue and Works have said."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「地之相去如此其遠，彼中利害，安得悉知？

translations.literal: The emperor said, "The places are so far apart; how can all the benefits and harms there be known?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "The places are so far apart; how can all the benefits and harms there be known?

sentences.zh: 惟委行省盡心措畫可也。」

translations.literal: Only entrust the traveling secretariat to plan with all its heart."
translations.idiomatic: Only entrust the traveling secretariat to plan with all its heart."

sentences.zh: 四月，以田櫟言河防事，上諭旨參知政事持國曰：「此事不惟責卿，要卿等同心規畫，不勞朕心爾。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, because Tian Li had spoken about river defense, the emperor issued an edict to Participation Councillor Chiguo: "This matter is not only your responsibility; I need you all to plan with one heart, so that my mind is not troubled.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, because Tian Li had spoken about river defense, the emperor issued an edict to Participation Councillor Chiguo: "This matter is not only your responsibility; I need you all to plan with one heart, so that my mind is not troubled.

sentences.zh: 如櫟所言，築堤用二十萬工，歲役五十日，五年可畢，此役之大，古所未有。

translations.literal: As Tian Li says, building the dike will use two hundred thousand units of labor; if fifty days are worked each year, it can be completed in five years. A labor project this great is unprecedented.
translations.idiomatic: As Tian Li says, building the dike will use two hundred thousand units of labor; if fifty days are worked each year, it can be completed in five years. A labor project this great is unprecedented.

sentences.zh: 況其成否未可知，就使可成，恐難行也。

translations.literal: Moreover, whether it can succeed is not yet known, and even if it can succeed, I fear it will be hard to carry out.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, whether it can succeed is not yet known, and even if it can succeed, I fear it will be hard to carry out.

sentences.zh: 遷徒軍戶四千則不為難，然其水特決，尚不知所歸，儻有潰走，若何枝梧。

translations.literal: Moving four thousand military households is not difficult, but if the water is simply breached, one still does not know where it will go; if it breaks out and runs off, how will it be supported and held?
translations.idiomatic: Moving four thousand military households is not difficult, but if the water is simply breached, one still does not know where it will go; if it breaks out and runs off, how will it be supported and held?

sentences.zh: 如令南岸兩處疏決，使其水趨南，或可分殺其勢。

translations.literal: If the two places on the south bank are dredged and breached so that the water tends south, perhaps its force can be divided and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: If the two places on the south bank are dredged and breached so that the water tends south, perhaps its force can be divided and reduced.

sentences.zh: 然水之形勢，朕不親見，難為條畫，雖卿亦然。

translations.literal: But the shape and force of the water are hard to plan in detail when I have not seen them personally; even for you it is so.
translations.idiomatic: But the shape and force of the water are hard to plan in detail when I have not seen them personally; even for you it is so.

sentences.zh: 丞相、左丞皆不熟此，可集百官詳議以行。」

translations.literal: The Chancellor and the Left Chancellor are both unfamiliar with this; gather the hundred officials for detailed deliberation and then carry it out."
translations.idiomatic: The Chancellor and the Left Chancellor are both unfamiliar with this; gather the hundred officials for detailed deliberation and then carry it out."

sentences.zh: 百官鹹謂：「櫟所言棄長堤，無起新堤，放河入梁山故道，使南北兩清河分流，為省費息民長久之計。

translations.literal: The hundred officials all said, "What Tian Li says, abandoning the long dike, not raising a new dike, and releasing the river into the old course of Liangshan so the South and North Qing Rivers divide the flow, is a lasting plan to save expense and rest the people.
translations.idiomatic: The hundred officials all said, "What Tian Li says, abandoning the long dike, not raising a new dike, and releasing the river into the old course of Liangshan so the South and North Qing Rivers divide the flow, is a lasting plan to save expense and rest the people.

sentences.zh: 臣等以為黃河水勢非常，變易無定，非人力可以斟酌，可以指使也。

translations.literal: Your servants believe that the water force of the Yellow River is extraordinary and changes without fixed pattern; it cannot be weighed and measured by human strength, nor can it be commanded by pointing.
translations.idiomatic: Your servants believe that the water force of the Yellow River is extraordinary and changes without fixed pattern; it cannot be weighed and measured by human strength, nor can it be commanded by pointing.

sentences.zh: 況梁山濼淤填已高，而北清河窄狹不能吞伏，兼所經州縣農民廬井非一，使大河北入清河，山東必被其害。

translations.literal: Moreover, Liangshan Marsh is already high with silt, and the North Qing River is narrow and cannot swallow the water; in addition, along the prefectures and counties through which it passes there are many farmers' cottages and wells. If the Great River is made to enter the Qing River to the north, Shandong will certainly suffer its harm.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Liangshan Marsh is already high with silt, and the North Qing River is narrow and cannot swallow the water; in addition, along the prefectures and counties through which it passes there are many farmers' cottages and wells. If the Great River is made to enter the Qing River to the north, Shandong will certainly suffer its harm.

sentences.zh: 櫟又言乞許都水監符下州府運司，專其用度，委其任責，一切同於軍期，仍委執政提控。

translations.literal: Tian Li also says that he requests permission for the Directorate of Waterways to issue tallies to the prefectures, route offices, and Transport Commission, monopolize the expenditures, be entrusted with responsibility, make everything the same as military deadlines, and still have an executive official assigned to supervise.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Li also says that he requests permission for the Directorate of Waterways to issue tallies to the prefectures, route offices, and Transport Commission, monopolize the expenditures, be entrusted with responsibility, make everything the same as military deadlines, and still have an executive official assigned to supervise.

sentences.zh: 緣今監官已經添設，又於外監署司多以沿河州府長官兼領之，及令佐管勾河防，其或怠慢已有同軍期斷罪的決之法，凡櫟所言無可用。」

translations.literal: But the Directorate officials have now already been increased, the outside inspectorates and offices have often also been concurrently led by chiefs of riverine prefectures and counties, and magistrates and assistants have been ordered to manage river defense. If any are negligent, there is already a fixed law to sentence them under the same rules as military deadlines. None of what Tian Li says can be used."
translations.idiomatic: But the Directorate officials have now already been increased, the outside inspectorates and offices have often also been concurrently led by chiefs of riverine prefectures and counties, and magistrates and assistants have been ordered to manage river defense. If any are negligent, there is already a fixed law to sentence them under the same rules as military deadlines. None of what Tian Li says can be used."

sentences.zh: 遂寢其議。

translations.literal: Then shelved the deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The plan was shelved.

sentences.zh: 八月，以河決陽武故堤，灌封丘而東，尚書省奏：「都水監、行部官有失固護。」

translations.literal: In the eighth month, because the river breached the old Yangwu dike and flooded Fengqiu eastward, the Secretariat memorialized, "The Directorate of Waterways and the traveling-office officials failed in firm protection."
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, because the river breached the old Yangwu dike and flooded Fengqiu eastward, the Secretariat memorialized, "The Directorate of Waterways and the traveling-office officials failed in firm protection."

sentences.zh: 詔命同知都轉運使高旭、武衛軍副都指揮使女奚列奕小字韓家奴同往規措。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Transport vice commissioner Gao Xu and Martial Guard deputy commander Wanyan Yilie (courtesy Hanjianu) together to go plan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Xu of Transport and Wanyan Yilie of the Martial Guard were sent to organize repairs.

sentences.zh: 尚書省奏：「都水監官前來有犯，已經戒諭，使之常切固護。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized, "The officials of the Directorate of Waterways had committed offenses before and had already been admonished, so that they would always be urgent in firm protection.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat memorialized, "The officials of the Directorate of Waterways had committed offenses before and had already been admonished, so that they would always be urgent in firm protection.

sentences.zh: 今王汝嘉等殊不加意，既見水勢趨南，不預經畫，承留守司累報，輒為遷延，以至害民。

translations.literal: Now Wang Rujia and the others paid no special attention. After seeing the water force tend south, they did not plan in advance; receiving repeated reports from the Defender's Office, they delayed, until the people were harmed.
translations.idiomatic: Now Wang Rujia and the others paid no special attention. After seeing the water force tend south, they did not plan in advance; receiving repeated reports from the Defender's Office, they delayed, until the people were harmed.

sentences.zh: 即是故違制旨，私罪當的決。」

translations.literal: This is deliberate violation of the imperial command; as a private offense, it should receive a fixed beating."
translations.idiomatic: This is deliberate violation of the imperial command; as a private offense, it should receive a fixed beating."

sentences.zh: 詔汝嘉等各削官兩階，杖七十罷職。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Rujia and others each stripped two ranks, beaten seventy, dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: Rujia and the rest lost two ranks, took seventy blows, and were dismissed.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「李愈論河決事，謂宜遣大臣往，以慰人心，其言良是。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers, "Li Yu's discussion of the river breach said that a great minister should be sent to comfort the people's hearts; his words are truly right.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers, "Li Yu's discussion of the river breach said that a great minister should be sent to comfort the people's hearts; his words are truly right.

sentences.zh: 向慮河北決，措畫堤防，猶嘗置行省，況今方橫潰為害，而止差小官，恐失眾望，自國家觀之，雖山東之地重于河南，然民皆赤子，何彼此之間。」

translations.literal: Earlier, when we worried that the river north of the river would breach, we planned dike defenses and even set up a traveling secretariat. How much more now, when it is breaking across and doing harm, yet only minor officials are assigned; I fear this disappoints the people's hopes. From the state's perspective, though Shandong may be more important than Henan, the people are all my children. What distinction is there between them?"
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when we worried that the river north of the river would breach, we planned dike defenses and even set up a traveling secretariat. How much more now, when it is breaking across and doing harm, yet only minor officials are assigned; I fear this disappoints the people's hopes. From the state's perspective, though Shandong may be more important than Henan, the people are all my children. What distinction is there between them?"

sentences.zh: 乃命參知政事馬琪往，仍許便宜從事。

translations.literal: Then ordered participation councillor Ma Qi to go, still permitted expedient action.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qi, participation councillor, was sent with full discretion.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「李愈不得為無罪，雖都水監官非提刑司統攝，若與留守司以便宜率民固護，或申聞省部，亦何不可使朕聞之。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Li Yu cannot be considered guiltless. Although officials of the Directorate of Waterways are not under the judicial commissioner's control, if he had, together with the Defender's Office, used discretion to lead the people in firm protection, or had reported to the Secretariat and the ministries, how could he not have let me hear of it?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Li Yu cannot be considered guiltless. Although officials of the Directorate of Waterways are not under the judicial commissioner's control, if he had, together with the Defender's Office, used discretion to lead the people in firm protection, or had reported to the Secretariat and the ministries, how could he not have let me hear of it?

sentences.zh: 徒能張惶水勢而無經畫，及其已決，乃與王汝嘉一往視之而還，亦未嘗有所施行。

translations.literal: He could only make alarmed noise about the water force and had no plan; after it had breached, he merely went with Wang Rujia to inspect it and returned, and he never carried anything out.
translations.idiomatic: He could only make alarmed noise about the water force and had no plan; after it had breached, he merely went with Wang Rujia to inspect it and returned, and he never carried anything out.

sentences.zh: 問王村河口開導之月，則對以四月終，其實六月也，月日尚不知，提刑司官當如是乎？」

translations.literal: When asked the month for opening and guiding the Wang village river mouth, he answered the end of the fourth month, when in fact it was the sixth month. He does not even know the month and day. Should an official of the judicial commissioner's office be like this?"
translations.idiomatic: When asked the month for opening and guiding the Wang village river mouth, he answered the end of the fourth month, when in fact it was the sixth month. He does not even know the month and day. Should an official of the judicial commissioner's office be like this?"

sentences.zh: 尋命戶部員外郎何格賑濟被浸之民。

translations.literal: Soon ordered Revenue aide He Ge to relieve the stricken people.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue aide He Ge was sent to relieve the flooded counties.

sentences.zh: 時行省參知政事胥持國、馬琪言：「已至光祿村周視堤口。

translations.literal: At the time, Participation Councillors Xu Chiguo and Ma Qi of the traveling secretariat said, "We have reached Guanglu village and inspected all around the dike mouth.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, Participation Councillors Xu Chiguo and Ma Qi of the traveling secretariat said, "We have reached Guanglu village and inspected all around the dike mouth.

sentences.zh: 以其河水浸漫，堤岸陷潰，至十餘裏外乃能取土。

translations.literal: Because the river water spreads and soaks, and the dike banks have sunk and collapsed, soil can only be taken from more than ten li away.
translations.idiomatic: Because the river water spreads and soaks, and the dike banks have sunk and collapsed, soil can only be taken from more than ten li away.

sentences.zh: 而堤面窄狹，僅可數步，人力不可施，雖窮力可以暫成，終當複毀。

translations.literal: The dike surface is narrow, only a few paces wide, so human labor cannot be applied; even if one exhausts strength to complete it temporarily, in the end it will again be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The dike surface is narrow, only a few paces wide, so human labor cannot be applied; even if one exhausts strength to complete it temporarily, in the end it will again be destroyed.

sentences.zh: 而中道淤澱，地有高低，流不得泄，且水退，新灘亦難開鑿。

translations.literal: The middle course is silted and deposited, the ground has highs and lows, and the flow cannot be released; moreover, after the water recedes, the new shoals will also be hard to cut open.
translations.idiomatic: The middle course is silted and deposited, the ground has highs and lows, and the flow cannot be released; moreover, after the water recedes, the new shoals will also be hard to cut open.

sentences.zh: 其孟華等四埽與孟陽堤道，沿汴河東岸，但可施功者，即悉力修護，將于農隙興役，及凍畢工，則京城不至為害。」

translations.literal: As for the four sao of Menghua and the Mengyang dike road, along the east bank of the Bian River, wherever work can be applied, exert all strength to repair and protect them. If labor is begun in the farming slack and completed by the freeze, then the capital will not suffer harm."
translations.idiomatic: As for the four sao of Menghua and the Mengyang dike road, along the east bank of the Bian River, wherever work can be applied, exert all strength to repair and protect them. If labor is begun in the farming slack and completed by the freeze, then the capital will not suffer harm."

sentences.zh: 參知政事馬琪言：「都水外監員數冗多，每事相倚，或複邀功，議論紛紜不一，隳廢官事。

translations.literal: Participation Councillor Ma Qi said, "The outside officials of the Directorate of Waterways are redundant in number; in every matter they rely on one another, or else compete for merit, and their discussions are confused and inconsistent, ruining official business.
translations.idiomatic: Participation Councillor Ma Qi said, "The outside officials of the Directorate of Waterways are redundant in number; in every matter they rely on one another, or else compete for merit, and their discussions are confused and inconsistent, ruining official business.

sentences.zh: 擬罷都水監掾，設勾當官二員。

translations.literal: We propose abolishing the aides of the Directorate of Waterways and setting up two managing officials.
translations.idiomatic: We propose abolishing the aides of the Directorate of Waterways and setting up two managing officials.

sentences.zh: 又自昔選用都、散巡河官，止由監官辟舉，皆諸司人，或有老疾，避倉庫之繁，行賄請托，以致多不稱職。

translations.literal: Also, from the past, when chief and roving river-patrol officers were selected, they were only recommended by Directorate officials; they were all men from various offices, and some were old or sick, avoiding the complexity of granaries and storehouses, bribing and using requests and influence, so that many were unfit for office.
translations.idiomatic: Also, from the past, when chief and roving river-patrol officers were selected, they were only recommended by Directorate officials; they were all men from various offices, and some were old or sick, avoiding the complexity of granaries and storehouses, bribing and using requests and influence, so that many were unfit for office.

sentences.zh: 擬升都巡河作從七品，于應入縣令兼舉人內選注外，散巡河依舊，亦于諸司及丞簿廉舉人內選注，並取年六十以下有精力能幹者。

translations.literal: We propose raising the chief river-patrol post to rank lower seventh and selecting and appointing it from among those eligible to enter county magistracies and from recommended men; roving river-patrol officers should remain as before, also selected and appointed from among men of the various offices and among assistants and registrars recommended for integrity, and all should be under sixty, energetic, and capable.
translations.idiomatic: We propose raising the chief river-patrol post to rank lower seventh and selecting and appointing it from among those eligible to enter county magistracies and from recommended men; roving river-patrol officers should remain as before, also selected and appointed from among men of the various offices and among assistants and registrars recommended for integrity, and all should be under sixty, energetic, and capable.

sentences.zh: 到任一年，委提刑司體察，若不稱職，即日罷之。

translations.literal: After one year in office, the judicial commissioner's office should be entrusted to inspect them; if they are unfit, dismiss them that very day.
translations.idiomatic: After one year in office, the judicial commissioner's office should be entrusted to inspect them; if they are unfit, dismiss them that very day.

sentences.zh: 如守禦有方，致河水安流，任滿，從本監及提刑司保申，量與升除。

translations.literal: If they have methods for guarding and defending, causing the river water to flow peacefully, then at the end of their term they should be jointly guaranteed by this Directorate and the judicial commissioner's office and promoted as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: If they have methods for guarding and defending, causing the river water to flow peacefully, then at the end of their term they should be jointly guaranteed by this Directorate and the judicial commissioner's office and promoted as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 凡河橋司使副亦擬同此選注。」

translations.literal: All chiefs and deputies of the River Bridge Office should also be selected and appointed according to this."
translations.idiomatic: All chiefs and deputies of the River Bridge Office should also be selected and appointed according to this."

sentences.zh: 繼而胥持國亦以為言，乃從其請。

translations.literal: Soon after Xu Chiguo also spoke thus; then followed their request.
translations.idiomatic: Chiguo agreed; the throne approved.

sentences.zh: 閏十月，平章政事守貞曰：「馬琪措畫河防事，未見功役之數，加之積歲興功，民力將困，今持國複病，請別遣有材幹者往議之。」

translations.literal: In the intercalary tenth month, Grand Councillor Shouzhen said, "In Ma Qi's planning of river-defense matters, the number of work units has not yet been seen, and with works having been raised for years, the people's strength is about to be exhausted. Now Chiguo is also ill; I request that another talented and capable man be sent to deliberate on it."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary tenth month, Grand Councillor Shouzhen said, "In Ma Qi's planning of river-defense matters, the number of work units has not yet been seen, and with works having been raised for years, the people's strength is about to be exhausted. Now Chiguo is also ill; I request that another talented and capable man be sent to deliberate on it."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「堤防救護若能成功，則財力固不敢惜。

translations.literal: The emperor said, "If dike defense and rescue can succeed, then of course wealth and labor cannot be grudged.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "If dike defense and rescue can succeed, then of course wealth and labor cannot be grudged.

sentences.zh: 第恐財殫力屈，成而複毀，如重困何？」

translations.literal: I only fear that wealth will be exhausted and strength bent, that it will be completed and then destroyed again. What will be done about doubling the hardship?"
translations.idiomatic: I only fear that wealth will be exhausted and strength bent, that it will be completed and then destroyed again. What will be done about doubling the hardship?"

sentences.zh: 宰臣對曰：「如盡力固護，縱為害亦輕，若恬然不顧，則為害滋甚。」

translations.literal: The chief ministers replied, "If all strength is used in firm protection, even if there is harm it will be light; if one is complacent and pays no attention, then the harm will become greater."
translations.idiomatic: The chief ministers replied, "If all strength is used in firm protection, even if there is harm it will be light; if one is complacent and pays no attention, then the harm will become greater."

sentences.zh: 上曰：「無乃因是致盜賊乎？」

translations.literal: The emperor said, "Will this not perhaps cause bandits?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Will this not perhaps cause bandits?"

sentences.zh: 守貞曰：「宋以河決興役，亦嘗致盜賊，然多生於凶歉。

translations.literal: Shouzhen said, "When Song raised labor because of river breaches, it did once cause bandits, but most arose from famine.
translations.idiomatic: Shouzhen said, "When Song raised labor because of river breaches, it did once cause bandits, but most arose from famine.

sentences.zh: 今時平歲豐，少有差役，未必至此。

translations.literal: Now the age is peaceful and the harvest is abundant; with a little labor assignment, it will not necessarily come to this.
translations.idiomatic: Now the age is peaceful and the harvest is abundant; with a little labor assignment, it will not necessarily come to this.

sentences.zh: 且河防之役，理所當然，今之當役者猶為可耳。
